mapper.sql: SELECT q.QUERY_ID, q.DATASOURCE_ID, q.QUERY_CODE, q.QUERY_NAME, q.DESCRIPTION, q.QUERY_SQL, q.OWNER_TYPE, q.OWNER_USERNAME, q.OWNER_DEPT_CODE, q.VALUE_COLUMN, q.LABEL_COLUMN, q.COLOR_COLUMN, q.CACHE_ENABLED_YN, q.CACHE_TTL_SECONDS, q.SORT_ORDER, q.LAST_EXECUTED_AT, q.LAST_RESULT_COUNT, q.USE_YN, q.CREATED_AT, q.CREATED_BY, q.UPDATED_AT, q.UPDATED_BY, q.DELETED_AT, q.DELETED_BY, d.DATASOURCE_CODE, d.DATASOURCE_NAME, d.DB_TYPE AS DATASOURCE_DB_TYPE, uo.NAME AS OWNER_NAME, uc.NAME AS CREATED_BY_NAME, uu.NAME AS UPDATED_BY_NAME FROM TB_EXTERNAL_QUERY q LEFT JOIN TB_EXTERNAL_DATASOURCE d ON q.DATASOURCE_ID = d.DATASOURCE_ID LEFT JOIN TB_USER uo ON q.OWNER_USERNAME = uo.USERNAME LEFT JOIN TB_USER uc ON q.CREATED_BY = uc.USERNAME LEFT JOIN TB_USER uu ON q.UPDATED_BY = uu.USERNAME
mapper.select:
WHERE q.USE_YN = 'Y'
ORDER BY q.SORT_ORDER, q.QUERY_NAME

WHERE q.DATASOURCE_ID = #{datasourceId}
ORDER BY q.SORT_ORDER, q.QUERY_NAME

WHERE ( q.QUERY_CODE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR q.QUERY_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR q.DESCRIPTION LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY CASE WHEN q.QUERY_NAME LIKE CONCAT(#{keyword}, '%') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, q.QUERY_NAME

WHERE q.OWNER_TYPE = 'GLOBAL' AND q.USE_YN = 'Y'
ORDER BY q.SORT_ORDER, q.QUERY_NAME

WHERE q.OWNER_TYPE = 'USER' AND q.USE_YN = 'Y' AND q.OWNER_USERNAME = #{username}
ORDER BY q.SORT_ORDER, q.QUERY_NAME
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_EXTERNAL_QUERY ( DATASOURCE_ID, QUERY_CODE, QUERY_NAME, DESCRIPTION, QUERY_SQL, OWNER_TYPE, OWNER_USERNAME, OWNER_DEPT_CODE, VALUE_COLUMN, LABEL_COLUMN, COLOR_COLUMN, CACHE_ENABLED_YN, CACHE_TTL_SECONDS, SORT_ORDER, USE_YN, CREATED_BY ) VALUES ( #{datasourceId}, #{queryCode}, #{queryName}, #{description}, #{querySql}, COALESCE(#{ownerType}, 'USER'), #{ownerUsername}, #{ownerDeptCode}, COALESCE(#{valueColumn}, 'value'), COALESCE(#{labelColumn}, 'label'), #{colorColumn}, COALESCE(#{cacheEnabledYn}, 'N'), COALESCE(#{cacheTtlSeconds}, 300), COALESCE(#{sortOrder}, 0), COALESCE(#{useYn}, 'Y'), #{createdBy} )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_EXTERNAL_QUERY SET DATASOURCE_ID = COALESCE(#{datasourceId}, DATASOURCE_ID), QUERY_NAME = COALESCE(#{queryName}, QUERY_NAME), DESCRIPTION = #{description}, QUERY_SQL = COALESCE(#{querySql}, QUERY_SQL), VALUE_COLUMN = COALESCE(#{valueColumn}, VALUE_COLUMN), LABEL_COLUMN = COALESCE(#{labelColumn}, LABEL_COLUMN), COLOR_COLUMN = #{colorColumn}, CACHE_ENABLED_YN = COALESCE(#{cacheEnabledYn}, CACHE_ENABLED_YN), CACHE_TTL_SECONDS = COALESCE(#{cacheTtlSeconds}, CACHE_TTL_SECONDS), SORT_ORDER = COALESCE(#{sortOrder}, SORT_ORDER), USE_YN = COALESCE(#{useYn}, USE_YN), UPDATED_BY = #{updatedBy}, UPDATED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE QUERY_ID = #{queryId} AND DELETED_AT IS NULL
UPDATE TB_EXTERNAL_QUERY SET USE_YN = #{useYn}, UPDATED_BY = #{updatedBy}, UPDATED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE QUERY_ID = #{queryId} AND DELETED_AT IS NULL
UPDATE TB_EXTERNAL_QUERY SET DELETED_BY = #{deletedBy}, DELETED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE QUERY_ID = #{queryId} AND DELETED_AT IS NULL
UPDATE TB_EXTERNAL_QUERY SET DELETED_BY = #{deletedBy}, DELETED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE DATASOURCE_ID = #{datasourceId} AND DELETED_AT IS NULL
UPDATE TB_EXTERNAL_QUERY SET SORT_ORDER = #{sortOrder}, UPDATED_BY = #{updatedBy}, UPDATED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE QUERY_ID = #{queryId} AND DELETED_AT IS NULL
